name: AI Transcription Agent - Backend
description: AI Meeting Transcription Agent — automatic speech-to-text, speaker diarization, summarization, and memory

scripts.transcribe:backend: cd python-backend && source venv/bin/activate && python3 main.py
scripts.transcribe:all: concurrently "npm run transcribe:backend" "npm run transcribe:bridge" "npm run transcribe:runner"
scripts.electron:install: cd agent-runner && npm install --loglevel=error && cd ../bridge-server && npm install --loglevel=error && cd ../electron && npm install
